subject: Request: Introductory Grant + 1M token trial extension — exception request
messages:
From: Sofia Ramirez <sofia@pathfinderhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — trial extension + credits for POC

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the KV caching examples. We have a small internal POC running next month and I wanted to check whether Redwood can offer a 6-week trial extension and an introductory credit grant to cover higher evaluation volume.

High level:
- We expect ~1M tokens of usage (generation + embeddings) during the POC.
- Desired: 6-week extension on the sandbox account, plus a $20k credit to offset cost while we benchmark two flows.
- If the POC looks good, we anticipate a purchase order for Dedicated capacity (quarterly commit) in Q4.

Are those things you can approve or should I loop in procurement? We hope to get the tests underway by Jun 15.

Attachments: Pathfinder_Request_Details.pdf (1 page summary)

Thanks,
Sofia Ramirez
Head of ML Platforms
Pathfinder Health
From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Hi Sofia — really glad the demo landed. I can provision a 6-week sandbox extension today. For the $20k introductory credit, I'll need a quick exception sign-off since it's above standard self-serve grants.

Two asks from my side to speed approval:
1) Can you share the intended success criteria (latency/throughput targets) and an approximate go/no-go date?
2) Any legal/procurement requirements (PO timeline) we should be aware of?

I'll escalate internally and get back within the day.

Best,

Subject: Fwd: Pathfinder — request for 6-week extension + $20k intro credit (exec approval request)

Marissa / Aditya —

Forwarding a prospect ask from Pathfinder Health. Summary below: 6-week sandbox extension + $20k credit to cover ~1M tokens while they run a POC. They indicated potential Dedicated commit in Q4 if benchmark looks good. Deal ID: PF-2027-1187, linked in HubSpot.

Why I'm asking for exception: $20k exceeds our standard quick-grant bands for non-enterprise accounts; Pathfinder is mid-market but strategic in health vertical (we flagged regulatory fit). I think this is a high-leverage ask: short lead time to demo results and clear runway to buy Dedicated.

Proposed approval terms (what I want sign-off on):
- Approve $20,000 credit (applied to account sandbox) valid only for POC window.
- 6-week sandbox extension starting Jun 15.
- Contingency: if Pathfinder does not engage procurement / provide go/no-go within 8 weeks post-extension, credits revert.
- Optional: 15% first-year committed discount if they sign a 12-month Dedicated commitment within 90 days.

Attachments: Proposed_Terms_JW_v1.pdf (one-page term summary).

Can you please approve or suggest edits? If you want to escalate to finance/legal, tell me who to loop.

Thanks,
Jonas
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pathfinder — request for 6-week extension + $20k intro credit (exec approval request)

Jonas — good write-up. I'm fine approving the credits + extension with the following firm conditions:

1) Credit cap: $20,000, non-transferable, expires 6 weeks after activation.
2) Revenue trigger: Pathfinder must enter a signed LOI or PO for a minimum quarterly Dedicated commitment (>$30k TCV) within 90 days to unlock the optional 15% discount.
3) Risk control: require that the sandbox be set to telemetry-on (we capture token-level usage and quality signals) and include a short success criteria doc (Sofia to provide).
4) Legal: no additional legal carveouts — use standard trial T&Cs. If procurement pushes custom terms, pause credits until Legal signs off.

I approve given the health vertical fit and forward pipeline potential. Aditya — FYI for quota and forecast modeling. Vivek — flagging potential enterprise motion if they convert.

Jonas, please confirm you will: activate the extension on Jun 15, notify Sofia with the exact credit code, and paste the HubSpot link to the deal. I'll mark as approved in our internal approvals thread.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — North America
